captions.instagram:
Customers see the store. They never see the system behind it: inventory, staffing, store management, advertising, service and construction timing.

As the Wiz chain grew, I built our own construction and fixture company, so building became part of the system too.

Save the 5-point system check.

#Operations #Retail #SmallBusiness

Which system would you fix first?
captions.facebook:
The best store experience depends on systems customers never see. I listed six of them, and the last slide is my 5-point check.

#Operations #SmallBusiness

Which part of your business runs on one person's memory?
captions.linkedin:
The experience is only as strong as the system behind it.

Customers see the store. Behind it sit inventory flow, staffing, store management, advertising, customer service and construction timing.

As the Wiz chain grew, I built an in-house construction and prefabricated fixture manufacturing company, so the buildout became part of the system.

A 5-point check: Is inventory flowing? Are teams staffed and trained? Is each store run to one standard? Is advertising coordinated? Is the buildout on schedule?

#Operations #Scaling

Which of these is your weakest link?
